title: unified cheesy ethiopian injera tibs
description: a fusion of earthy ethiopian flavors with the comfort of melted cheese, perfect for kids and ovo-vegetarians.
instructions: preheat the ttukbaegi earthenware cookware over medium heat.
mix the injera flour and water to form a smooth batter, set aside for 30 minutes.
heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in the ttukbaegi, add the chopped onion and sauté for 3-4 minutes.
add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
add the berbere spice, black pepper, and salt, stir well.
add the shredded cheddar cheese and stir until melted, then add the ricotta cheese and stir until well combined.
add the chopped onion mixture to the cheese mixture and stir well.
add the dry white wine and stir well.
using a spatula, spread a thin layer of the cheese mixture onto the ttukbaegi.
place the injera bread on top of the cheese mixture, cut into pieces and serve.
reheat the remaining cheese mixture if needed, serve hot.
